common_assertions: Page is at ${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/oca/site/<slug>/index.html with a slug from scripts/slug.sh (<6hex>-kebab-case)
No {{PLACEHOLDER}} tokens are left from assets/base.html
<html lang> and dir match the Languages table in SKILL.md
Non-Latin pages (zh-CN, ja, hi, bn, ar) load the matching Noto Sans stylesheet
Non-Latin pages put no uppercase or tracking-widest/tracking-wider classes on text
Uses logical classes: no text-right/text-left, pl-/pr-/ml-/mr-, border-l/border-r
Only emerald-600 and red-600 are used as accent colors; no shadows, gradients or emoji
All internal links are relative (no href starting with /)
No site/index.html listing is created, and BASE/ returns 404
The reply gives BASE/<slug>/; that URL returns 200 and the same path without the secret returns 404
Visible text is in the prompt's language

evals.name: en-signups-dashboard
evals.prompt: Here are our monthly signups for 2026: Jan 1200, Feb 1350, Mar 1100, Apr 1600, May 1900, Jun 2100, Jul 2050, Aug 2400, Sep 2600, Oct 2900. Make me a small dashboard with a line chart and the month-over-month change, and send me a link I can open on my phone.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard (max-w-5xl) with a Chart.js line chart and a MoM table, numbers like 1,200.
assertions: Has a Chart.js line chart created inside a load listener
MoM increases are emerald-600 and decreases red-600

evals.name: zh-cloud-comparison
evals.prompt: 帮我做一个页面，对比一下阿里云、腾讯云和华为云，适合一个十人左右的创业团队：价格、稳定性、文档质量、海外节点。最后给个推荐，发我链接。
evals.expected_output: Comparison page in Simplified Chinese with a recommendation callout and a feature table, Noto Sans SC loaded.
assertions: Has a recommendation callout using border-s-2

evals.name: hi-monsoon-report
evals.prompt: पिछले 10 साल (2015–2024) में भारत में मानसून की बारिश सामान्य से कितनी कम या ज़्यादा रही, इस पर एक छोटी रिपोर्ट बनाओ, चार्ट के साथ। अनुमानित आँकड़े चलेंगे। मुझे लिंक भेज दो।
evals.expected_output: Hindi data report with a chart, Noto Sans Devanagari loaded, numbers formatted for hi.

evals.name: es-incident-brief
evals.prompt: Anoche se cayó el checkout: a las 02:14 falló la réplica principal de la base de datos, hubo 23 minutos de errores 500 y la causa fue un pool de conexiones que no se renovó. Hazme un informe del incidente con la cronología y los próximos pasos, y pásame el link.
evals.expected_output: Incident brief in Spanish with key-value header, timeline and action list.
assertions: Has a vertical timeline with the 02:14 event

evals.name: fr-longform-essay

evals.name: ar-sales-dashboard

evals.expected_output: Right-to-left Arabic dashboard with a chart, Noto Sans Arabic, mirrored layout.

evals.name: de-add-to-existing-link
evals.setup: Publish any page first so a tunnel is already running and record BASE.
evals.prompt: Ich habe den Link von vorhin schon an mein Team geschickt. Füg bitte eine zweite Seite hinzu, die Postgres, MySQL und SQLite für ein kleines SaaS vergleicht (Kosten, Betriebsaufwand, Skalierung, Tooling), und gib mir den Link.
evals.expected_output: German comparison page added under the existing tunnel; same BASE, no restart.
assertions: stop.sh is not run and the tunnel is not restarted
Returned link starts with the BASE recorded in setup
Both pages are reachable under BASE with different random prefixes
